name: Hex Blast
description:
About This Game

Hex Blast is a horde survival x roguelike deckbuilder where you strategize on a hex grid, chaining explosive card combos to wipe out cyber hordes.

Boot up your robot—each with unique abilities and a customizable deck—to firewall your core systems against relentless viral hordes!Discover devastating synergies: Shatter the battlefield with earthquake builds, transform defense into offense with shield fortresses, or engineer entirely new combos.

Build your deck, acquire powerful chips, and refine the ultimate engine to outsmart ever-adapting cyber threats—before they overwhelm you.

Key Features:

  • 4 Playable Robots - each with their own unique cards and relics

  • 200+ cards and relics - infinite synergies to discover

  • Tactical Hex Grid - position cards for explosive chain reactions

  • Evolving cyber threats - adapt as enemies mutate into deadlier forms and swarm in relentless waves

  • Endless replayability - no two runs play the same
short_desc: Hex Blast is a horde survival x roguelike deckbuilder where you strategize on a hex grid, chaining explosive card combos to wipe out cyber hordes. Build your deck, collect overclocked chips, and discover the most broken builds to annihilate cyber threats—before they overwhelm you.
